Title: Skin of Night and Rötshreck Q

Messages.Author: Tuomas Rinta
Messages.Body:
A question arose during playing yesterday, so here goes:

Could Skin Of Night used to "prevent" Rötshreck? If, let's say I control
a vamp that bleeds and is blocked by a vamp, with let's say Ivory Bow,
and I know that that player uses Rötshreck. If I play Skin of Night in
the beginning of the round, then the opposing minion could not inflict
aggravated damage, right? So could he still play Rötshreck? Is it the
possibility to inflict aggravated regardless of the conditions (except
for manouvers)?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tuomas Rinta wrote:
> A question arose during playing yesterday, so here goes:
> Could Skin Of Night used to "prevent" Rötshreck? If, let's say I control

No.

> a vamp that bleeds and is blocked by a vamp, with let's say Ivory Bow,
> and I know that that player uses Rötshreck. If I play Skin of Night in
> the beginning of the round, then the opposing minion could not inflict
> aggravated damage, right? So could he still play Rötshreck? Is it the

Yes.

> possibility to inflict aggravated regardless of the conditions (except
> for manouvers)?

It is the "attempt to use" aggravated damage "against a vampire" regardless
of the ultimate success level of that attempt.
Maneuvers are only useful in that they can keep the attempt from being
"against a vampire" by removing the vampire from harms way.
